definitions.explanation: Finely ground powder made from specially grown and processed green tea leaves. Used in the traditional tea ceremony and widely as a flavoring in sweets and drinks.

{抹茶|まっちゃ}⟦アイス→アイス：06770_aisu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。

notes:
WRITING:
{抹|まつ} (rub/grind) + ⟦{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧ (tea). Literally "ground tea."

TEA CEREMONY:
In ⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧ (the tea ceremony), {抹茶|まっちゃ} is whisked with hot water using a ⟦{茶筅|ちゃせん}→茶筅：23829_chasen⟧ (bamboo whisk). The verb for preparing matcha is ⟦{点|た}てる→点てる：13403_tateru⟧, not ⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (which is used for ordinary tea).

There are two main styles:
- {薄茶|うすちゃ}: thin tea (lighter, more common)
- {濃茶|こいちゃ}: thick tea (richer, more formal)

MODERN USAGE:
{抹茶|まっちゃ} has become hugely popular as a flavor in modern Japan and globally. Common products include {抹茶|まっちゃ}ラテ (matcha latte), {抹茶|まっちゃ}⟦アイス→アイス：06770_aisu⟧ (matcha ice cream), and {抹茶|まっちゃ}⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧ (matcha cake).

- {抹茶|まっちゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{点|た}てる→点てる：13403_tateru⟧: to prepare matcha
